desc: Parse `p` into `A`, `B`, and `C`, with correct boundary semantics for empty segments.
Implement deterministic KMP occurrence enumeration for each nonempty literal segment.
Use sorted occurrence lists and `bisect_left` to select the earliest compatible `B` and `C` occurrences.
Handle empty segments as matching every boundary from `0` through `len(s)`, including `p == "**"` and boundary-ending matches.
Run the supplied examples and comprehensive edge-case tests against the current implementation.
